notes.title: Drago Entertainment is releasing Gas Station Simulator tomorrow!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/6e099306eeb612f0a1f450100e9ffee8c6584568.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! 

Our friends over at DRAGO entertainment have been working on a new game that is being released tomorrow, [b]September 15th[/b] at 7pm CEST. As we are all part of one big developer family, we would like to spread this exciting news for a really deserving and fun game. 

If you ever wanted to restore and run an old [b]gas station[/b] on Route 66, that is your chance. 
Visit their Steam page below for more information: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149620/Gas_Station_Simulator/

notes.title: Gas Station Simulator? Yes please!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38970777/4c58bccacfc459ccf048579d92b6b7816f679864.png[/img]

Our friends over at [b]DRAGO entertainment[/b] have been working on a new simulation game that is being released very soon. You’ve probably heard of it, it’s called the [b]Gas Station Simulator[/b] and it’s a great, fun game in which you are running your own petrol station, with all its perks and cons. As we are all part of one big, [b]Polish developer family[/b], we would like to spread this exciting news. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149620/Gas_Station_Simulator/

If you’re into simulation games, we know you’re going to enjoy this one, so go on and [b]add it to your wishlist[/b] now. It’s coming out on the [b]15th of September[/b] already!

notes.title: Our Survival Collection is growing!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/5144945cd373cb412fe39baaac8adae32247de5a.png[/img]

Learn more about our latests project, Serum!

After you woke up, the first thing you’ve noticed was the mysterious plug with a timer on your arm. 
You realise quickly that to survive you will have to find the healing Serum. 

In our game, you’re intoxicated with a deadly virus that is slowly killing your body. The only way to survive is by applying a special serum that will extend your life by only a couple of hours.
You don’t know who and why but you know one thing. Life is in your hands now and your only choice is to race against the time.
Do you have what it takes to reveal the secrets of the mysterious Serum? Find out the truth about its creators and purpose!  

[b]Watch the trailer for our latest game - Serum! [/b]

notes.title: Game Island's Community Discord
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38970777/9fd7e7d98a9fcaa7e588a1263402c20a48d74709.png[/img]

To all Survivors from around the world! 
Finally, we’ve found a safe space without radiation and anomalies. We repeat, we’ve found a safe space for all the Survivors and it’s our community Discord server!

Join other fans of the Survival genre and be always up to date with news from our studio!
You will find there all the news and information about our titles.
 Also, if you have any feedback, ideas to share or you just want to simply hang out with developers and bother us with questions, we’re there for you! Don’t hesitate and join our Discord today.
Be a part of the development and help us make better games!

notes.title: Devlog#06: Weather conditions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38970777/4059552c55f63e05e554fbc48ad81082e6cf6de9.gif[/img]

In the desert, everything can kill you. Various creatures, poisonous plants, lack of water and food or even a temperature.

In the final version of the Deadly Deserty environment and even weather might be deadly. That's why before leaving for scavenging you should always look for the shelter first!
Remember to be always prepared for every necessity.

[url=https://www.facebook.com/GameIslandSA/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38970777/5bd9bdf8e0edd790211e05598a3c3ef09063f3e7.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog#04: First step to crafting
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38970777/45ac6b6701da3dd596f371cc749a7a13fdc9aa26.jpg[/img]

In the world of survival, crafting is one of the most important arts! 
Who would know how many things you can make out of just one cactus!

In the final build of the Deadly Desert, everything you find in the desert will help you survive - even inconspicuous cactus!  

Can you guess which plant would help you survive severe dehydration?

notes.title: Devlog#01: self care
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38970777/a8df762c228965ec00b9fe1a94d5264f3d7214f1.gif[/img]

notes.title: Hi everyone!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

A few words from us.
First of all, we are glad you added Deadly Desert to your wishlist! This means a lot to us because this is our very first title on Steam.

We will try to show you game content and the progress of work on the production as often as possible. If you like Deadly Desert, share the game page with your friends and write what things you would like to see in the game.

In the first devlog we want to show you the biggest enemy you will meet in Deadly Desert - nature.
